notes.text: Closed 2026-09-18 on the evidence of UI-G0 (merge 24b2c65) and UI-G1 (merge 2382e56), verified on main with tools/study-consumer/verify.py (full publish, 192 JVM / 181 JS). Clause by clause: isolated consumer against packaged artifacts = verify.py copies only the consumer, rejects checkout paths and checks the reader classpath jar by jar against the local publish; custom comparison and detector through public interfaces = the scaled cosine (MethodExecution.Bounded via mapScore) and CustomDetector running through RecordingExecution; published laws = ExecutionLaws and ManifestLaws over six consumer routes plus the existing comparison/detector law suites; typed parameters/results and versioned codecs = consumer descriptors, parameter codecs, score codec and detector registration archived under manifests; save and rerun without editing core interpreters = fresh-process reload in a separate JVM with bit-exact rerun; unknown/duplicate versions and invalid parameters as named errors = UnsupportedSchema/MissingMethod/MissingResultCodec/DuplicateResultCodec and descriptor refusals; headless consumer lists capabilities (recipe descriptors, execution capability), explains unmet prerequisites (preflight blockers as coded diagnostics), inspects/diffs/loads/runs plans (StudyPreview, ChangedPlan with field diff, manifests, runners), consumes results (ResultInspection drill-down to CSV records), observes FS2 progress and cancellation (segments with exact totals, Cancelled without result). Documented limits are listed in the plan's G1 outcome.
